service_enforcement.CONTROL_DEVICE_STATE: requestState has a top-app AND foreground-app AND app-requestable-state exemption. Cancellation has a separate feature-gated rule. Base-state overrides explicitly invoke permission enforcement. Effective device flags/state configuration were not checked.
service_enforcement.CONTROL_DISPLAY_BRIGHTNESS: Seven methods invoke generated permission-enforcement helpers. Those helper bodies are uncaptured, so their exact exception implementation is not established; other brightness APIs have different checks.
service_enforcement.INJECT_EVENTS: The inspected injectInputEventToTarget Binder method explicitly throws SecurityException when its check fails, before clearing caller identity. The check permits the service process and, when enabled for that method, an instrumentation source that independently holds permission. There is no own-target-UID exemption in this method.
